book.name: Roome
book.title: Kiristoos Yisa Tarjamonnante Kinin Yittsaa Bhawloos Roome Eenana Kinin Thaapoono Warqanno

content: Kinka Kinka Kiam Tiya Zaskayno
Yesa shaarinte Barjodar woylamin qajadhenka dadi maataa eedi dahaa ki hanna, kiam tiyee; kisa qaabondar pirdeebhode.

Yena kamsi i giye: Barjodar woylamin qajaynasa eedi kalaa “Inta gala wulam itsana damayda dame” kida hame; waa pir Barjodar woylamin qajadhenka dadi maataa ea “Inta haaqansa aapinbee hacchanbe bish ida itse” kida hame.
Ogonante yer wulam itsea itsimaam ki bagabhoode; haaqansa aapinbee hacchanbe bish itsea yer wulam itseadar ki pirdabhoode. Harrna hambhidianna, kiamaar Barjo tiydine.
Ogonante ya waa easa waadiman eadar pirdea hayne? Harrna hambhidianna, ki woydiannaar ki dhambidiannaar kisa imbaasane, hantitehe. Ko dahaannaar Barjo kiam woysana kinin damenna, woya ki woye.

Ogodettsi eedi kalaa “Rooroa waa rooroa waadara sagi gobshi kisa daane” hamayse kida bhocche; waani pir “Roorona wulsa gobshino kiaddhane” hamayse kida bhocche. Ogonante eedi wul yisa woylaminka qothimima ko bhocche.

Rooroam gobshea Imbaa wontea Yesusna hamayse kida gobshe. Itsear Barjoam kinin gobshenna, Imbaa wontea Yesusna hamayse kida itse; itsimaar Barjoam kinin gobshenna, Imbaa wontea Yesusna hamayse itsima kida gare.
Wosa iira kala hattear yimetenna dehea qolehe; pir yimetennaar diyea qolehe.
Sadaka dahaa wo dahaakaar Imbaa wontea Yesusna woda dee; wo diyaakaar Imbaa wontea Yesusna woda diye. Ta sadaka wo dahaakaar, wo diyaakaar wodi Imbaa wontea Yesussane.
Ogona Kiristoos diyayse dembhira kinin dhaabhoono, sadanka dahayna eenabee diyaana eenabesa Imba maatanane.
Ta ogona ya hambanaasadar harrnaa pirde? Pir hambanaasaam harrnaa bage? Wodi wul Barjosa pirdin birante woyooda woye.
Harrna hambhidianna,

content.text: “Barjo ‘Inta lay dehea Barjo inin dohonna, gon ida giye:
Eeno wul ina kumpurdha ko kumpurdhe;
kedi wulaar Barjo inin dohonam tarja ke tarje’ ki hamade”

content: hamayse thaapadhidine.
Ogonante wodi kalaa kalaana wonnon metensa Barjona malsi woda maase.
Eedina Goa Maata Woam Zaskimoono
Ta keeda waa waadar wo pirdabhoode; yesa imbanaanana goa yenin maatoamadettsi yeam toolee.
Meten yinnonka gala qays konin dahaamonam inta Imbaa wontea Yesus Kiristoos goynka dhesidine. Ko dahaannaar eedi kalaa “Kaa gala qaysine” hamayse qaabea ki hanna, ogono galano gon kina qaysine.
Galan goynka hambanaasaam genea hanna, ya nashimmakkoka deheatehe. Ogonante Kiristoosin yina diyaa hambanaasaam hasa galanka kiam kaysaabhode.
Ta keeda yennon shaarinte payya maaton yerinam waani eenin “siyane” hamayse bagoadettsi hayeebhode.
Barjosa bitamono Manpas Gazanka haapadhayno tipamobee, payyamobee, wozabe gantine; itsamobee wucadhenbe gantitehe.
Ogo goynka Kiristoosna waadadhea ea Barjoam kida wozise; eedi birantear gobshadhaa kida maate.
Ogonante payyamonam haapadhenbee kinka kinka kiam wonin wocchinsenbeam wo zage.
Galana hamayse Barjosa waadimanam kaysaabhode. Gala wul qaysitehe; ko dahaannaar een waanina goa maaten galanam itsano siyane.
Ogonante waa itsintabee, wucadhenam wucintabee, yerin waaniam hanin hayenbe hambanaasana goa maatea ko hanna garinta payyane.
Yerra iginaka gonne hanin hamayno hambee Barjobesa shaarinte ko dee. Harrna hambhidianna, “Kono tipane” hamayse yinin giyen yerinam qothimima waadadhea ea gobshadhaane.
Qothimada itsea eedi daa ki hanna, kisa waadimano gon konin dahaamonna, kidar pirdadhidine. Harrna hambhidianna, gonne hamayse kinin waadadhaammo yer wul kina seesone.
